lesson.title: Polite Ways to Order and Make Requests at a Restaurant

concept.explanation_zh: 礼貌点餐表达是指在餐厅点餐时使用的礼貌语言和句型，能让交流更自然且让服务员感到尊重。比如用“Could I please have...”或“Would you mind if I...”等表达方式。这些短语既能表达请求，又不会显得强硬。
examples: Could I please have the grilled chicken with a side salad?
Would you mind if I change my order to the vegetarian pasta?
May I add an extra drink to my order, please?
concept.common_mistake_zh: 很多人直接说“I want...”或“Give me...”，这在正式或服务场合中显得不够礼貌。正确的表达是使用‘Could I please have...’替代‘I want...’，使语气更委婉和尊重。

vocabulary.explain_in_english: A small food item served with the main dish
vocabulary.usage_note_zh: 餐厅点餐时常用，属于口语和正式场合都适合的表达。
examples: I’d like a steak with mashed potatoes as a side dish.
Can I get a side dish of steamed vegetables?

vocabulary.pronunciation_tip_zh: 重音在‘special’和‘day’，‘of the’连读成/əv ðə/
vocabulary.explain_in_english: A dish that the restaurant recommends for that day
vocabulary.usage_note_zh: 常见于餐厅服务对话，正式和非正式场合均可。
examples: What is the special of the day today?
I’ll have the special of the day, please.

vocabulary.pronunciation_tip_zh: ‘make’重音，‘substitution’三个音节，重音在第三节
vocabulary.explain_in_english: To change one item in a dish for another
vocabulary.usage_note_zh: 常用于点餐时请求换菜或食材，语气礼貌，适用于正式场合。
examples: Can I make a substitution and have fries instead of rice?
They allowed me to make a substitution on my order without extra charge.

scene.title: Changing a Dish After Ordering at a Restaurant
scene.context_zh: 在餐厅点完菜后，发现想换一道菜，如何礼貌地向服务员提出请求。
scene.script_en: Customer: Excuse me, I just ordered the grilled salmon, but after thinking about it, I realized I’d prefer something else. Would it be possible to substitute the salmon for the grilled chicken instead? Waiter: Of course! No problem at all. Would you like to keep the same side dishes, or would you prefer to make a change? Customer: Actually, I’d like to change the side dish as well. Could I have steamed vegetables instead of the fries, please? Waiter: Absolutely, that’s a great choice. And would you like anything to drink with your meal? Customer: Just water for now, thank you. Waiter: Perfect. I’ll update your order and make sure everything is ready as soon as possible. Customer: Thank you very much for being so helpful. I really appreciate it. Waiter: You’re very welcome! If there’s anything else you need, just let me know.
scene.translation_zh: 顾客：打扰一下，我刚点了烤三文鱼，但想了想，发现我更想吃别的。能不能把三文鱼换成烤鸡肉？服务员：当然可以，完全没问题。您想保持配菜不变，还是想换一下？顾客：实际上，我也想换配菜。请问可以把薯条换成蒸蔬菜吗？服务员：没问题，这个选择很好。您用餐时想喝点什么吗？顾客：先来杯水，谢谢。服务员：好的。我会更新您的订单，尽快为您准备。顾客：非常感谢您的帮助，我很感激。服务员：不客气！如果您还需要什么，请告诉我。
scene.practice_tip_zh: 练习使用‘Would it be possible to...’和‘substitute’这些礼貌表达，帮助你在餐厅需要更改订单时说得自然且尊重对方。

reading.title: A Dinner to Remember
reading.text_en: Last Saturday evening, I decided to try a new restaurant in town that had received excellent online reviews. The menu looked tempting, and I was eager to taste something different. When the waiter came to take my order, I politely asked about the special of the day. He described a fish dish that sounded delicious, so I chose it. After a few bites, I found that the fish’s flavor was a bit too strong for my liking. I didn’t want to be rude, so I waited patiently until the waiter passed by again. Then I said, “Excuse me, could I please make a substitution? I’d prefer the chicken instead, if that’s okay.” The waiter smiled warmly and assured me that it was no problem at all. He even suggested adding a side dish of mashed potatoes to complement the chicken, which sounded perfect. I agreed happily, and shortly after, my new dish arrived. The chicken was tender and flavorful, and the mashed potatoes were creamy and delicious. I was truly glad that I had politely asked to change my order rather than just eating something I didn’t enjoy. This experience taught me how important polite language is in creating a positive atmosphere between customers and staff. After finishing my meal, I thanked the waiter for his excellent service. It was definitely a dinner to remember—not just because of the food, but because of the friendly and respectful interaction that made the evening special.
reading.summary_zh: 故事讲述作者在一家新餐厅点餐时因为口味不合，礼貌地请求更换菜品，最终享受美味晚餐的经历。故事强调礼貌用语对服务体验的重要性。

questions.question: Why did the author decide to change the dish?
questions.answer: Because the fish dish was too strong in flavor for the author.

questions.question: What did the waiter suggest to go with the chicken?
questions.answer: He suggested adding a side dish of mashed potatoes.
